column1: # One row per clause. The question: does it ACTUALLY fire, and what saw it?
# WITNESS    exactly one of three dispositions, and no clause may have none. Either the
#            occasion algebra extends it (its fingerprint is a regex on
#            tool_input.command, so tests/test_occasion_algebra.py ranges over it), or a
#            session in eval/corpus drives it through the real dispatcher and requires
#            the denial to name it, or a LIVE waiver parks it with research and an
#            expiry. That totality is itself a law:
#            Neither disposition is a subset of the other and a clause may have both.
# LABEL      machine-checked: the totality law is part of the suite, and a lapsing
#            waiver reddens it with no edit -- inaction restores the demand.
